title: Senior Java Backend Engineer
description_raw: Seeking a Senior Java Backend Developer with 5+ years of experience designing and deploying microservices using Java 17, Spring Boot, Kafka, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, and AWS. Must have deep expertise in multithreading, distributed caching with Redis, CI/CD pipelines, and high-throughput transaction systems.
responsibilities: Architect and implement low-latency REST and gRPC microservices.
Design database schemas and optimize PostgreSQL query execution plans.
Maintain 99.99% service uptime across Kubernetes production clusters.
